issues.problem: Both entries say the wrong NIP-0003 feature creates the runtime_session directory. slot_rule says NIP-0003 feature 109 (provisionally 116) adds the runtime_session row 'in the same change that creates tools/fixtures/runtime_session/ and its suite', and the follow-up asks for the NIP to be revised to say the same. The NIP says otherwise. Feature 108 (provisionally 115) delivers tools/runtime_session.py together with 'a language-neutral stub runtime (tools/fixtures/runtime_session/stub_runtime.py) and tools/test_runtime_session.py' (source=docs/nips/NIP-0003-live-runtime-sessions.md section='Reference tooling (phase 016)' line=367-380). Feature 109 contributes only the claim map (line=381-386). The id shift 108->115, 109->116 is at source=docs/planning/backlog_reconciliation.md section=5.3 line=208-209,218. So feature 109's change never creates the directory, and the rule as written cannot be followed. It also hides a real constraint. The spec requires an unclaimed subdirectory to FAIL (source=.agent/feature_list_014.json features[105].description). That means the change that first creates tools/fixtures/runtime_session/ (feature 108/115) must register the row itself. This is in tension with the spec's statement that 116 registers it (source=.agent/product_spec_014.md section='Maintenance tranche -- design decisions', 105 bullet, line=179-183). The contract states the NIP's design wrongly and would pass that error into the NIP pre-acceptance revision.

issues.problem: No check proves that each printed demonstration label tests its own failure mode. pinned_interface says _claim_map_case applies exactly one defect and requires one output line naming that defect, but no AT or S-check verifies it. S05 cases 12 and 13 only swap claim_map_check for a constant-pass or constant-fail version, which removes all four OK lines at once. S04 checks only where the line is printed, and S06 checks only containment. Concrete counterexample: a _claim_map_case that applies the unclaimed defect in all four cases and checks only rc==1 with one line would print all four OK lines. It would pass AT2, S04, S05 (all 13 cases), S06 and AT1. The line 'OK   claim-map   doubly-claimed subdirectory -> FAIL' would then be printed without any doubly-claimed demonstration. That makes the spec's 'The self-test demonstrates those three negative cases itself' (source=.agent/feature_list_014.json features[105].description) vacuous. Each label must be tied to its own failure mode, not to the function's behaviour as a whole.
